title: fix(app-shell,plugin-detail): the record activity panel says "no permission to view activity" when its read is refused, instead of an empty list (objectui#11195)
body:
Fixes #11195
Clause-②: yes (widening)

## What was wrong

An invited member of a hosted AI-built app opened a record (objectstack-ai/cloud#2485). The server refused the record's `sys_activity` read with a 403, and the activity panel showed an empty list with no message. The member could not tell "no activity" from "not allowed to see activity".

Every feed read ended in a catch that treated any failure as an empty answer:

- `RecordDetailView` (the console record page): both feed reads, `sys_activity` and `sys_comment`, ended in an empty `.catch` handler, and `Promise.allSettled` then counted the failed read as answered. A 403 landed on "No comments yet".
- `record:activity` (plugin-detail): the self-fetch's `.catch` set the feed to `[]` for every failure, so a 403 landed on "No activity recorded".

## What changed

- **One verdict, reused.** `isRefusedFeedRead(err)` in plugin-detail's `recordActivityFeed.ts`, exported from the package barrel beside `activityRowToFeedItem`. It is the `forbidden` and `unauthorized` kinds of the existing `classifyLoadError` read classifier (`@object-ui/react`), and it reads no status or code of its own. Both surfaces call it.
- **`RecordDetailView` keeps a verdict per source.** Each read records "refused or not" under the same per-record key the rows use (`feedRefusalByRecord`), so a refusal on one record never reaches another. An answered read clears it. The host passes `activityDenied` / `commentsDenied` on its `DiscussionContextProvider`.
- **`DiscussionContext`** (`@object-ui/react`) gains the two optional members `activityDenied` / `commentsDenied`, in the provider's memo list as primitives.
- **`record:activity`** records its self-fetch's refusal in state beside `fetched`. With a host context it shows the host's two flags instead. Host `items` carry no refusal.
- **`record:chatter` / `record:discussion`** pass the context's flags through `RecordChatterPanel` to the timeline.
- **`RecordActivityTimeline`** takes `activityDenied` / `commentsDenied`. With no rows, a refusal replaces the empty state: a lock and a left-aligned sentence, not the centred inbox glyph. With rows on screen, the rows stay and the notice sits above them. Only the i18n sentence is rendered: no status, no server message, no object name.
- **Strings:** `detail.activityAccessDenied` and `detail.commentsAccessDenied`, in all ten locale packs and in `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS`. No existing key fit: `attachmentsAccessDenied` names attachments.
- Changeset: `minor` for plugin-detail and react, which gain published surface (plugin-detail's root export `isRefusedFeedRead` and the optional `activityDenied` / `commentsDenied` on `RecordActivityTimelineProps` / `RecordChatterPanelProps`; react's `DiscussionContextValue` gains the same two optional members); `patch` for app-shell and i18n. The `record:activity` section of the plugin-detail guide gains "When the read is refused".

## Decisions the card left open, and what this PR does

- **A refused `sys_comment` beside an answered `sys_activity`.** The comment half of the same panel gets the same treatment. The activity rows stay on screen, and the notice above them reads "You don't have permission to view comments on this record." Both refused, with no rows, shows both lines.
- **401 counts as refused**, per the triage on the card (any refused read: 401 / 403, or a permission envelope). This differs on purpose from `RecordAttachmentsPanel`, whose `denied` state does not claim a 401. The verdict's docblock records why.
- **Not refused, so the empty state stays:** a 200 with zero rows; a 404 (the ObjectStack adapter already answers a bare 404 as zero rows; another adapter's 404 classifies as `network`); `OBJECT_API_DISABLED` / `OBJECT_API_METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED` (`api-disabled`: a property of the object, not of the caller); a 400; a 500. The panel has no error state, so a 500 still settles on the empty state. See Acceptance notes.
- **No retry.** A refusal is written into state. No effect dependency moves with it, and nothing re-issues the read. Both surfaces pin this.

## Verification (head `df5a91cb4`, after merging `origin/main` at `9419df198`)

- New pins, both surfaces: `RecordDetailView.feedRefusal-11195.test.tsx` (7 tests) and `record-activity.refusedRead-11195.test.tsx` (10 tests). They cover: a 403 envelope and a 401 show the no-permission state with no retry; the 200-zero-rows control shows the empty state; a 404 and a 500 do not show "no permission"; a refused comment read keeps the activity rows; the host-context path; and the verdict's refused and not-refused sets.
- Merged tree, one run: all `RecordDetailView*` suites, the `record-activity*` / `record-chatter*` renderer suites, `all-locales-key-parity`, `en-zh-key-parity` and `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack`: **49 files, 355 tests passed**.
- Before the merge (branch head `2fbe2df5f`): `packages/plugin-detail/` whole: 226 files passed (1 skipped), 2245 tests passed. The `RecordDetailView*` suites plus `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack`, `widget-dom-leak-sweep`, `palette-discussion-alias`, apps/console `record-block-record-reach` and `packages/react/src/context`: 57 files, 653 tests passed. `packages/i18n/` whole: 74 files passed, 1216 tests passed (13 skipped).
- `type-check`: `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/react` and `@object-ui/i18n` all exit 0 (dependency closure built first, `@object-ui/app-shell^...`).
- `eslint` on the 21 changed ts/tsx files: 0 errors.
- Gates, exit 0: `check-changeset-presence` (1 changeset, 4 released packages), `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check:i18n-keys`, `check:i18n-drift` (2 keys added, 0 en values changed), `check:i18n-dead-keys`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `markdown-test-inputs --audit`, `check:doc-types`, `check:doc-fences`, `check:doc-example-ids`, `check:phantom-deps`, `check:self-import`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`.
- NOT MEASURED: `check:doc-snippets` / `check:doc-examples` (exit 2, precondition not met: packages outside this diff's closure are unbuilt; the docs edit adds prose and no code fence). The root `scripts/__tests__/` suite was not run: the shared verify lock queued for over an hour. This diff edits no script and adds no test that reads markdown. CI runs it.

## Ablation (one leg, at the shared verdict, head `df5a91cb4`)

`isRefusedFeedRead` was made to answer "not refused" for every rejection, which turns a refusal back into the empty list on both surfaces. The mutation went through `ablation-replace.mjs`: the anchor was hit 1 time and went to 0, the marker went from 0 to 1, and the blob changed. The subject reaches the tests through the vitest source alias for `@object-ui/plugin-detail`, so no build sat in between.

- Mutated: **8 failed, 9 passed (17)**. The 8 red: the 403 and 401 pins and the no-retry pin on each surface, the refused-comment pin, and the verdict's refused set. The 9 green are the 200 / 404 / 500 controls on both surfaces, the two host-context pins, and the verdict's not-refused set. That is the expected direction.
- Restored: the blob equals the HEAD blob and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

## Acceptance notes (not filed; observations only)

- A read that fails without a refusal (a 500, an unreachable server) still renders the empty state, "No comments yet" / "No activity recorded". That sentence is a claim about the record, made without evidence. The panel has no error state; `RecordAttachmentsPanel`'s `unavailable` state is the house shape for one. The triage said this case "is reported"; it is out of this card's scope.
- `DiscussionContextValue.error` is declared, but no host sets it and no renderer reads it.
- When the `sys_comment` read is refused, the comment composer still renders. Whether the member may WRITE a comment they may not READ is a server question; this PR does not change the composer.
